name: ANT-GPS-A active GPS antenna
document: AAC Clyde Space ANT-GPS-A datasheet (28 April 2023)
notes: L1 patch (1575.42 +-12 MHz), RHCP, built-in 33 dB LNA with 3.5 dB noise figure, axial ratio 2 dB, VSWR < 2:1, SMA female. Antenna gain 5.0 dBic at zenith in free space (2.5 dBic on a ground plane; 4.2 dBic at 60 deg elevation, 0.7 at 30, -0.9 at 20, -2.3 at 10); passive_gain_dbi is the free-space zenith value. Powered from the GPS receiver through the RF cable. Dimensions include the connector; aluminium base with composite radome; vibration > 30 Grms; over 15 years of on-orbit heritage. Multi-channel models available (not described).

name: GNSS All-Bands Antenna
notes: 1160-1610 MHz: GPS L1/L2/L5, Galileo E1/E5a/E5b/E6, GLONASS G1/G2/G3, BeiDou B1/B2a/B2/B3, Inmarsat L-band (1525-1559 MHz). RHCP, reflection coefficient <= -10 dB, realized gain at boresight > 0 dBi (lower bound, not entered), axial ratio < 3 dB, phase centre variation < 0.4 mm within +-30 deg. Mass with connector 130 g, protruding height 8.7 mm, SMA female. Qualification temperature -120 / +120 C (not an operating range). TRL 8, developed under an ESA NAVISP contract. No amplifier mentioned.

name: GNSS L1/E1 Band Antenna
document: Anywaves GNSS L1/E1 Band Antenna datasheet (2020)
notes: Ceramic 3D-printed patch, central frequency 1.575 GHz, L1 1.563-1.587 GHz and E1 1.559-1.591 GHz, RHCP, realized gain > 5.5 dBi at boresight (> 4.3 at +-30 deg, > 1.1 at +-60 deg; passive_gain_dbi is the boresight lower bound), HPBW +-45 deg, axial ratio < 3 dB within +-40 deg, efficiency > 95%, mass with connector 86 +-2 g, protruding height 4.5 mm, SMA female. Simulated RF performance.

name: AHP5354A.07.0100C active GNSS L1/L5 patch
document: Taoglas Inception Series AHP5354A.07.0100C datasheet SPE-24-8-252-B
notes: Commercial (not space-qualified) active multiband patch with 2-stage LNA, 100 mm 1.37 mm coax cable and I-PEX MHF1 connector; 35 x 35 x 4 mm ceramic patch tuned on a 70 x 70 mm ground plane. Bands: BeiDou B1/B2a, GPS/QZSS L1/L5, GLONASS G1, Galileo E1/E5a. Gain, LNA gain and supply values are in tables not read here.

name: AHP54510.07.0100C active GNSS L1/L5/L-band patch
document: Taoglas Levity Series AHP54510.07.0100C datasheet SPE-24-8-007-B
notes: Commercial (not space-qualified) active dual-feed stacked patch (45 x 45 x 10 mm ceramic element, overall 60 x 60 x 15 mm, 100 mm coax with U.FL). Bands: GPS L1/L5, GLONASS G1, Galileo E1/E5a, BeiDou B1/B2a, QZSS L1/L5, IRNSS L5 and L-band. Mass, gain and supply not read.

name: CGSP457.A GNSS and SatCom patch
notes: Commercial (not space-qualified) ceramic patch 45 x 45 x 7 mm, RHCP, tested on a 70 x 70 mm ground plane; GNSS L1 1575.42, BeiDou B1 1561, GLONASS G1 1602 MHz, L-band 1542 MHz, Iridium and NTN n255. Passive element: mass and gain not read. Revision B of the same sheet was not used (older issue).
